title: Aluminium Works Price Guide 2026
description: A comprehensive guide to aluminium works pricing in Saudi Arabia for 2026, covering cost factors, system comparisons, and practical tips for getting the best quote.

pricingFactors.description: Thermally broken profiles cost 30–50% more than standard profiles
Double-glazed Low-E units raise cost by 20–40% compared to single glazing
Custom colours and metallic finishes add 10–20% to base cost
Larger projects benefit from lower unit prices due to economies of scale
High-level works require scaffolding and cranes, raising labour costs
Peak-season execution can raise labour costs by 15–25%

systemTiers.name: Economy
systemTiers.description: Standard aluminium profiles without thermal break, single glazing — suited to economy buildings and warehouses

systemTiers.name: High Performance
systemTiers.description: Thermal-break profiles with Low-E double glazing — most common for towers and offices

systemTiers.name: Premium
systemTiers.description: Curtain wall systems with triple glazing and bespoke architectural design — for prestige projects

howToGetBestPrice: Submit complete, detailed drawings and specifications for an accurate price, not estimates
Request multiple quotes and compare specifications, not price alone
Plan ahead and avoid urgent requests which carry emergency surcharges
Discuss phased project delivery to improve cash flow

faq.question: What is a ballpark price per m² for aluminium works in Riyadh?
faq.answer: Prices vary considerably by specification, so we always recommend requesting a detailed quote. Costs are influenced by profile type, finish, glass, installation complexity, project size, and site conditions.

faq.question: Is there room to negotiate on aluminium works pricing?
faq.answer: Yes. Factors that help improve pricing include large project volume, complete clear specifications, flexible scheduling, and early commitment before the peak demand season.

title: Glass Works Price Guide 2026
description: A comprehensive guide to glass works pricing in Saudi Arabia for 2026, covering all glass types, installation requirements, and factors that affect cost.

pricingFactors.description: Tempered, double-glazed, and Low-E glass cost more than standard float glass
Larger and thicker panels cost more and are harder to install
Frameless SSG and Spider-fix systems cost more than traditional framed systems
High-level works add significant equipment and safety costs
Ceramic printing, etching, and self-cleaning coatings add 25–50%
Large orders and flexible schedules improve unit pricing

systemTiers.name: Standard Glass
systemTiers.description: Single or standard double-glazed glass in a traditional aluminium frame — suitable for economy projects

systemTiers.name: High-Performance Glass
systemTiers.description: Low-E double-glazed with thermal frames — the optimal choice for towers and offices

systemTiers.name: Premium Structural Glass
systemTiers.description: SSG and Spider Glass facades without visible frames — for prestige architectural projects

howToGetBestPrice: Define glass specifications precisely (thickness, type, coating) before requesting quotes
Combine glass supply and installation in one contract for a better price
Plan orders in advance to avoid express delivery charges
Ask about bulk discounts and long-term maintenance contracts

faq.question: How much more does double-glazed glass cost than single-glazed?
faq.answer: Double-glazed IGU units typically cost 60–100% more than single-glazed glass, but deliver substantial electricity savings over time through improved thermal efficiency.

title: Steel Works Price Guide 2026
description: A comprehensive guide to steel structure and metalwork pricing in Saudi Arabia for 2026, with a breakdown of costs from design through installation.

pricingFactors.description: Raw steel cost represents 50–65% of total cost and tracks global metals markets
Complex geometric structures can double manufacturing costs
Hot-dip galvanising costs more than painting but lasts longer with less maintenance
Projects requiring large cranes and special site equipment add 15–30%
NDT tests and material certificates add 5–10% but are essential for government projects
Remote areas increase transport and logistics costs

systemTiers.name: Light Structures
systemTiers.description: Structures below 30 kg/m² for warehouses, hangars, and canopies — lowest cost

systemTiers.name: Medium Structures
systemTiers.description: Structures 30–60 kg/m² for factories and multi-storey industrial buildings

systemTiers.name: Heavy Structures
systemTiers.description: Structures over 60 kg/m² for bridges and heavy industrial facilities

howToGetBestPrice: Complete structural design and drawing approval before requesting quotes to avoid costly revisions
Provide complete BIM or CAD plans for accurate pricing without excessive contingency
Factor in periodic maintenance costs when comparing protection systems
Ask about supply-only options if you have a certified erection team

faq.question: How do I estimate the cost of a steel warehouse?
faq.answer: Cost is typically calculated by multiplying the steel structure weight (in tonnes) by the supply-and-erect rate per tonne. The structural designer determines weight based on loads and dimensions. For an accurate estimate, you need full dimensions, height, and cladding type.

title: Glass Curtain Wall Price Guide 2026
description: A specialist guide to glass curtain wall system pricing for commercial buildings and towers in Saudi Arabia for 2026.

pricingFactors.description: Unitized systems cost 30–50% more than stick systems but install significantly faster
Triple-glazed or smart glass can double the glass cost alone
Curved and irregular facades raise cost by 40–80%
BMU cleaning equipment falls outside the curtain wall contract but must be designed alongside it
Interior edge finishes may be included in the curtain wall contract or tendered separately
SBC-601 requirements may mandate higher-specification glass, raising cost

systemTiers.name: Stick System
systemTiers.description: Field-assembled element by element — lowest cost, best suited for small and medium buildings

systemTiers.name: Unitized System
systemTiers.description: Fully factory-assembled units — faster to install and higher quality for large towers

systemTiers.name: SSG / Point-Fixed
systemTiers.description: Frameless facades with structural silicone or Spider point-fixing

howToGetBestPrice: Decide on system type (Stick/Unitized) early as it significantly affects pricing
Complete wind and thermal load calculations before requesting quotes
Combining the curtain wall with internal aluminium works may save 5–10% overall
Plan and budget for the mockup phase in advance

faq.question: What is the cost difference between Stick and Unitized systems?
faq.answer: Unitized costs 30–50% more than Stick System, but installs 40–60% faster, reducing site equipment and labour costs on large projects.
